title: DesktopCompat accessible-name and IR WAV load entry-point regression gates
what_it_proves: winui-shell-check scans DesktopCompat Program.cs interactive controls for non-empty AccessibleName (12 found).
Removing any AccessibleName from DesktopCompat causes the gate to fail.
Removing the IR WAV load AutomationProperties.Name or OnPrepareIrClick handler from MainWindow.xaml causes the gate to fail.
Offline self-test covers valid, missing, empty DesktopCompat cases (10 total cases).
limitations: Source-level static scan only; no screen-reader/UI Automation runtime audit.
Does not prove physical audio playback, driver install/load, HLK or Microsoft signing.
